title: Strand Specific Detection of Overlapping Transcripts via Purification of Biotinylated cDNA
author: Faizan Uddin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfc5jiy6
materials: 2µg of DNase-I treated RNA was reverse transcribed at 55 ᵒ C using Superscript-III First-Strand Synthesis System for RT-PCR (Invitrogen 18068-015) in 40µl RT reaction following manufacturer’s instruction. The final concentration of each biotinylated GSP was 250nM.

steps.title: Prepare Streptavidin Beads
steps.instruction: Collect and wash Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Streptavidin C1.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 50µl of Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Streptavidin C1 to a 1.5ml tube and collect over a magnetic stand.
Wash the beads twice with 400µl of 1x binding buffer (1M NaCl, 1mM EDTA, 0.1% Tween-20, and 10mM Tris-Cl, pH 7.5).

steps.title: Bind Biotinylated cDNA to Beads
steps.instruction: Mix the beads with the RT reaction and incubate to capture cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 400µl of 1x binding buffer using gentle tapping (avoid using a pipette for dispersion).
Mix in 35µl of RT reaction.
Incubate the mixture at 15 ᵒC for 30 minutes with slow rotation.

steps.title: Remove Unbound cDNA
steps.instruction: Separate the beads from the supernatant using a magnetic stand.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube over the magnetic stand for 2 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant containing unbound cDNA.

steps.title: Denature cDNA-cDNA Duplexes
steps.instruction: Treat the bead pellet with NaOH to denature duplexes.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µl of 0.15M NaOH to the bead pellet.
Disperse beads with gentle tapping.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature with intermittent mixing.
Remove the supernatant using the magnetic stand.

steps.title: Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes to remove residual cDNA and buffer.

substeps.instruction: Wash once with 300µl of 0.1M NaOH to remove residual self-primed cDNA.
Wash twice with 400µl of 1x washing buffer (0.1M NaCl, 1mM EDTA, 0.1% Tween-20, and 10mM Tris-Cl, pH 7.5).

steps.title: Release Biotinylated cDNA
steps.instruction: Elute the biotinylated cDNA from the beads using heat.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 70µl of water.
Incubate at 70 ᵒC for 5 minutes.
Cool on ice to release the biotinylated cDNA.

steps.title: Recover Enriched cDNA
steps.instruction: Collect the enriched cDNA for downstream use.

substeps.instruction: Perform a short spin at 1500g at 4 ᵒC.
Transfer the enriched biotinylated cDNA to a fresh tube using the magnetic stand.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Use the enriched cDNA as a template for PCR.

substeps.instruction: Use 2µl of enriched biotinylated cDNA for PCR.
Carry out amplification under conditions optimized for each amplicon using gDNA and/or non-biotinylated cDNA as template.
